esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| EVAL _org_key = COALESCE(ess.billing.organization_id, cloud.account.id, "_default_")
| INLINE STATS org_earliest_ts = MIN(@timestamp), org_latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY _org_key
| WHERE deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != ""
| EVAL _row_obs = COALESCE(
    MV_MIN(group_observations),
    CASE(
      group_first_seen_at IS NOT NULL,
      CONCAT(
        "9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z\t1\t_row_\t",
        CASE(COALESCE(group_initial_backfill, false), "1", "0"),
        "\t",
        TO_STRING(group_first_seen_at)
      ),
      null
    )
  )
| STATS
    best_obs = MIN(_row_obs),
    first_bill_ts = MIN(@timestamp)
  BY _org_key, deployment_group, org_earliest_ts, org_latest_ts
| DISSECT best_obs "%{pol_created}\t%{exp_rank}\t%{emitter_id}\t%{bf_str}\t%{obs_ts_str}"
| EVAL first_obs_ts = TO_DATETIME(obs_ts_str),
       det_backfill = CASE(best_obs IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(TO_INTEGER(bf_str), 0), 0),
       first_seen = COALESCE(first_obs_ts, first_bill_ts)
| WHERE det_backfill == 0
    AND CASE(
      first_obs_ts IS NOT NULL,
      first_obs_ts >= NOW() - 3 days,
      org_latest_ts > org_earliest_ts AND first_bill_ts > org_earliest_ts AND first_bill_ts >= org_latest_ts - 3 days
    )
| STATS first_seen = MIN(first_seen) BY deployment_group
| EVAL first_seen_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(first_seen), 10),
       result = CONCAT("New chargeback group `", deployment_group, "` first observed on ", first_seen_day, ".")
| SORT deployment_group ASC
| KEEP result, deployment_group, first_seen_day
